mood: Immersive, gritty but highly polished, authoritative, cyber-tactical. Think high-end esports meets GTA V Los Santos at night.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for breathing room inside main containers.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol: MODE A ('TETRIS') for the landing page hero and features. MODE B ('CONTROL ROOM') for the 'My Applications' dashboard.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radii: Use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Sharp but approachable. NEVER use huge border-radii on everything, maintain a structural feel.
layout_and_spacing.surface_styles: Use the 'Tracing Beam' concept for active/highlighted recruitments. Use 'Retro-Futurism' (deep black, subtle cyan border glow) for standard cards.

cards.style: Flat background (#141418), 1px subtle border (border-white/10). On hover, subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and a cyan glow drop-shadow (hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.15)]).

buttons.primary: Solid #00E5FF background with black text. Font-bold, tracking-wide. Subtle outer glow. hover:bg-[#00E5FF]/90.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px border-white/20, text-white. Hover: border-[#00E5FF] and text-[#00E5FF].

forms.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. bg-black/40, border-white/10, focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]. Text is #FAFAFA.
forms.labels: Outfit text-sm text-zinc-300 font-medium. Error states in #EF4444.
forms.fields: Support short text (Input), long text (Textarea), single choice (RadioGroup/Select), multi choice (Checkbox).

badges.style: Small padding (px-2.5 py-0.5), font-mono text-xs uppercase. Background is 15% opacity of the text color.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism: bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Sticky top-0 z-50. Navigation must be visible on desktop.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have hover states. Use transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance animations for recruitment cards and application history using framer-motion.

hero_background.description: Cyberpunk alleyway with neon lights. MUST be overlaid with bg-black/80 to ensure text readability.

form_sidebar_background.description: Modern cityscape. Use on the side of the application form layout with a heavy bg-[#050505]/90 overlay.

decorative_element.description: Glowing video game controller. Can be used as a subtle banner inside the 'My Applications' header.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the dark backgrounds meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. The primary accent (#00E5FF) against black is highly legible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='recruitment-card-apply-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS strictly for all layout and styling. Do not write custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
Install framer-motion for entrance animations on the recruitment lists.

When building the layout, use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing/landing page structure, but heavily customized Shadcn components for the Application Forms (Input, Textarea, RadioGroup, Checkbox, Select).
CRITICAL: The hero image MUST have an overlay of at least bg-black/80. If you use it without overlay, it will ruin the contrast.

CRITICAL: Ensure that the fonts are imported via Google Fonts in index.html or global css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Unbounded:wght@300;400;700;900&display=swap');
Use Polish language throughout the UI exactly as requested: 'nowe', 'zaakceptowane', 'odrzucone', 'Aplikuj', 'Moje Aplikacje', etc.
